name: global-memory
description: Adds a machine-wide memory folder beside the per-project auto memory, so facts about the machine reach every session from any folder: rewrites the memory section for both folders and loads the global MEMORY.md.

globalDir.title: Global memory folder
globalDir.description: Folder of the machine-wide memory, with its own MEMORY.md. It can be a folder in a git repo, to version the memories. A leading ~ is your home folder.
